subject: Confirmed source corrections; remaining texture-span negative case
body:
Source confirmation only, not test release: C ComputeRegion now has flags; C/Rust descriptors64 and Rust total11496 match intended declarations; import_pipeline now uses info2.code_offset; cache retains hit before unlock and caller releases selected after job retain; Vk/Metal view fields separated; base/level offsets split; all level0 layers up to16 emitted. Re-hash before executing integration tests.

One remaining concrete span gate: bridge currently calculates backing_length=o->size-base_offset and passes this whole remaining allocation to n2t. It only checks D2_SPAN fits the BO, never that the actual layout fits D2_SPAN. A larger BO with valid16x16RGBA8 layout but wire span1 currently can pass helper validation even though the declared selected-view span is short. Bound helper validation by agreed wire view span (and relative-level origin consistently), or require computed exact layout end<=declared span. Positive nonzero-base test plus one-byte-short declared span inside a sufficiently large BO distinguishes this from simple BO bounds. Shared helper whole-layout validation should be the authority. Still no source approval of manifest unknown-view fields or missing SPD/LS.
